item_1_release_design.friction_identity_correction: incomplete as stated. Total friction = OCR error rate + admission-failure rate. A border-clipped capture never reaches the comparison; it fails materialization and routes to retake. The 52 are a friction bucket of their own and are not errors.
recorded: the OCR reading is compared with the national ID the user types by hand
reading matches the typed ID -> accept, at any confidence
mismatch, margin at or above the frozen value -> 'check the number you typed'
mismatch, margin below it -> 'retake the photo'
after a maximum number of retakes -> human review
the OCR never sees the typed value, and the reading is never shown to the user

item_7_phase_2m_g_correction.additional_scope_finding: the demo adapter does not use band_quad. It crops a fixed canonical bbox from configs/phase2l_b_fixed14_v2.json, which is hash-protected in ten places and on two phases' protected lists, so symmetrising would also create a train/serve mismatch.
item_7_phase_2m_g_correction.what_was_corrected: it needs a retrain and a new evaluation, and Phase 2M-G found zero band-clipped digits, so its precondition is absent. It moves to post-release research.
